'''Sizinnian''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Snivvian/Legends|Snivvian]], who lived during the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
Sizinnian was a [[Scholar/Legends|scholar]] and researcher who began producing an analysis of ''[[Journey of the Minds]]'', a 102-volume ancient Snivvian philosophical text. However, the intensity of his research led many of his acquaintances to question his sanity, so Sizinnian traveled the [[Southcentral Branch]] of the [[Eyar City Sewer]], to study alone. Sizinnian learned how to fool maintenance [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]] and bribed the sewers' maintenance workers to leave him alone, while he lived in a pair of unused chambers within the sewer.<ref name="HS" />

==Personality and traits==
Sizninnian was extremely paranoid and whenever he met anyone; he worried that they might steal his research.<ref name="HS" />
